company_clauses.title: Error-budget reporting
company_clauses.text:
## Error-budget reporting

`monthly_error_budget_consumed_pct` classified warning (≥80%) for two or more consecutive
reporting cycles must be reported to the Reliability Review Board at the next scheduled
meeting, regardless of trend direction — the shared policy's clause, restated here because it
is the primary SLO Cascade is held against.

shared_clauses.title: Cost and resource anomalies
shared_clauses.text:
## Cost and resource anomalies

A cycle's LLM/tool-call spend running well above its own recent trailing average is not, by
itself, evidence of anything the monitoring system can safely fix — there is no automated
"correct" spend level to revert to. Any such anomaly must be routed to human review with the
comparison (this cycle's figure against the trailing average) attached, so a human can account
for the cause, rather than being silently absorbed into an unremarked cost trend.

contributing_assessments.rationale: Error budget climbed further to 91% from 82% — 2nd consecutive warning-level cycle; RRB reporting clause applies regardless of trend direction.

cascade.rationale: Cycle spend well above trailing average, routed to human review with the comparison attached rather than silently absorbed — exactly what the clause requires.
